In this month’s Longteng Senior High School News, our reporter Jeremy interviews three students about some memorable first-time experiences in their lives.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
修飾語In this month’s Longteng Senior High School News,
主詞our reporter Jeremy
動詞interviews
受詞three students about some memorable first - time experiences in their lives.

基本句型：先找主詞與動詞，再判斷受詞／補語
Read their replies below.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
補語／片語Read their replies below.
閱讀以下他們的回答。

課文句型圖解

單字（音標 中文）字根字首同類單字（中英）同音／同義／反義單字搭配詞（雙語）
memorable [`mɛmərəbḷ]
難忘的 good or special and thus worth remembering; unforgettable
補充英文發音
構詞拆解：字尾 -able＝能…的
學測常用同字族（中英）：memorandum（備忘錄）／memorial（紀念館）／memorabilia（紀念品）／memoria（記憶）／memory（記憶）／memoriam（悼念）
補充英文發音
同義／語意相關詞：
unforgettable（令人難忘）
反義／相對概念：
historic（歷史悠久） eddy（漩渦） red（紅色） sir（先生） slim（苗條） eve（前夕） fatso（胖子） omaha（奧馬哈(omaha)）
同音／同形異義：
immemorable（難以忘懷）
近音詞：
immemorable（難以忘懷） measurable（可衡量的）
學測常用搭配：
memorable day＝難忘的一天
memorable and＝令人難忘和
memorable for＝難忘的
memorable in＝令人難忘的
memorable occasion＝難忘的時刻
memorable words＝難忘的話
a memorable＝令人難忘的
the memorable＝令人難忘的
most memorable＝最難忘的
that memorable＝那個難忘的
課本例句：The amazing white sand beaches, friendly people, and delicious food made our trip to Thailand truly memorable.
例句中文：令人驚嘆的白色沙灘、友善的人民和美味的食物讓我們的泰國之旅真正令人難忘。
補充英文發音
memorize [`mɛməˏraɪz]
記憶；記住
構詞拆解：字尾 -ize＝動詞字尾
學測常用同字族（中英）：memorandum（備忘錄）／memorial（紀念館）／memorabilia（紀念品）／memorable（難忘的）／memoria（記憶）／memory（記憶）／memoriam（悼念）
補充英文發音
同義／語意相關詞：
learn（學習）
反義／相對概念：
learn（學習） remember（記住） know（知道） remembering（記憶） study（研究） abhorred（憎惡）
同音／同形異義：
memories（回憶） mesmerize（迷惑） memorized（已記憶） memorise（記憶）
近音詞：
memories（回憶） mesmerize（迷惑） memorized（已記憶） memorise（記憶） mammaries（乳房） memorised（已記憶） moonrise（月出）
學測常用搭配：
memorize the＝記住
memorize a＝記住一個
memorize it＝記住它
memorize and＝記住和
memorize them＝記住它們

to memorize＝記住
and memorize＝並記住
not memorize＝不記得
can memorize＝能記住
課本例句：Nancy is good at memorizing texts within a very short period of time, but she usually forgets them after a few days.
例句中文：南希擅長在很短的時間內記住課文，但她通常幾天後就忘記了。
補充英文發音

課文句型圖解

課文句子句型結構樹中翻克漏字解析
It was October 28, 1886.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
修飾語It was October 28,
補語／片語1886.
時間是西元1886年10月28日。
基本句型：先找主詞與動詞，再判斷受詞／補語
Even though it was a rainy day in New York City, close to a million people were out for their first look at the city’s newest addition on Bedloe’s Island, which was later renamed Liberty Island.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
主詞Even though it was a rainy day in New York City, close to a million people were out for their first look at the city’s newest addition on Bedloe’s Island, which
動詞was later
補語renamed Liberty Island.
儘管在紐約市是一個下著雨的日子，仍有將近一百萬人外出，為了首次觀看這個城市在貝德羅島（後改名為自由島）上最新的成員。
被動語態：be＋p.p.
關係子句：who/which 修飾先行詞
不定詞：to＋原形動詞
When French sculptor Frédéric Auguste Bartholdi removed the large French flag from the front of his latest creation, the crowds cheered and the soldiers fired their guns in celebration.
S/V
Clause 1
連接詞When
主詞French sculptor Fr é d é ric Auguste Bartholdi removed the large French flag from the front of his latest creation, the crowds

課文句型圖解

課文句子句型結構樹中翻克漏字解析
Ada Ríos grew up in a slum near the Cateura landfill in Paraguay.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
補語／片語Ada R í os grew up in a slum near the Cateura landfill in Paraguay.
AdaRíos在巴拉圭的卡特烏拉垃圾掩埋場附近的貧民窟長大。
基本句型：先找主詞與動詞，再判斷受詞／補語
Every morning, garbage trucks rolled into the landfill and unloaded tons of trash.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
修飾語Every morning,
主詞garbage trucks
動詞rolled
受詞into the landfill and unloaded tons of trash.
每天早上，垃圾車會駛進垃圾掩埋場，卸下大量的垃圾。
V-ing：動名詞或分詞，依句中功能判斷

S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
主詞People in the slum then
動詞looked
補語through the trash for things they could recycle or sell.
貧民窟的居民會在垃圾中尋找他們可以回收或出售的東西。
情態助動詞＋原形動詞
This was how they made a living, and Ada believed her future would be no different.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
修飾語This was how they made a living,
主詞and Ada
動詞believed
受詞her future would be no different.
這就是他們謀生的方式，Ada相信她的未來也不會有所不同。
V-ing：動名詞或分詞，依句中功能判斷
情態助動詞＋原形動詞

that 子句：留意名詞子句或關係子句
Chávez.” Ada’s grandma knew Ada loved music, so she applied for Ada.

Lesson 8 ? Convenience Stores

21 29 ?

課文句型圖解

課文句子句型結構樹中翻克漏字解析
It has probably happened to you before.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
主詞It
動詞has probably
受詞happened to you before.
你以前大概也發生過這種事。
完成式：have/has/had＋p.p.
不定詞：to＋原形動詞
The glass doors of the convenience store slide open invitingly; you hear the familiar “Welcome!” and enter just to pick up one item.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
補語／片語The glass doors of the convenience store slide open invitingly; you hear the familiar “Welcome!” and enter just to pick up one item.
便利商店的玻璃門誘人地滑開；你聽見熟悉的「歡迎光臨！」，然後走進去只為了買一樣東西。
不定詞：to＋原形動詞
A few minutes later, you walk out with a whole bag full of drinks, snacks, and other goodies you never even thought of buying!
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
修飾語A few minutes later,
主詞you walk out with a whole bag full of drinks, snacks, and other goodies you never even
動詞thought
受詞of buying!
幾分鐘後，你走出來，手上拿著整袋飲料、點心，以及其他你甚至從未想過要買的好東西！
V-ing：動名詞或分詞，依句中功能判斷
There’s no need to be embarrassed if you’ve experienced this sudden urge to shop.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
主詞There’s no
動詞need to
受詞be embarrassed if you’ve experienced this sudden urge to shop.
如果你曾經歷過這種突然想購物的衝動，不需要感到不好意思。
被動語態：be＋p.p.
不定詞：to＋原形動詞
Convenience stores use certain strategies to make you feel this way.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
主詞Convenience stores
動詞use
受詞certain strategies to make you feel this way.
便利商店運用某些策略，讓你有這樣子的感覺。
不定詞：to＋原形動詞
One of these strategies is to follow the “eye level is buy level” rule.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
主詞One of these strategies
動詞is to
補語follow the “eye level is buy level” rule.
其中一項策略，就是遵循「視線高度等於購買高度」的規則。
不定詞：to＋原形動詞
The more visible the products are, the easier it is for shoppers to notice and purchase them.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
修飾語The more visible the products are,
主詞the easier it
動詞is
補語for shoppers to notice and purchase them.
商品愈容易被看見，顧客愈容易注意並購買它們。
不定詞：to＋原形動詞
Therefore, smart shop owners usually place their most profitable and popular items at the average shopper’s eye level to make sure that those items are most likely to be seen.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
修飾語Therefore,
主詞smart shop owners
動詞usually place
受詞their most profitable and popular items at the average shopper’s eye level to make sure that those items are most likely to be seen.
因此，聰明的店主通常把他們最有利潤及最受歡迎的商品，擺放在一般顧客的視線高度以確保那些商品最有可能被看見。
that 子句：留意名詞子句或關係子句
不定詞：to＋原形動詞
Similarly, products that are aimed at children, such as toys, are placed on lower shelves so that younger shoppers will surely see them.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
修飾語Similarly,
主詞products that are aimed at children, such as toys,
動詞are placed
補語on lower shelves so that younger shoppers will surely see them.
同樣地，以兒童為對象的商品，比如玩具，則被放在較低的貨架以便讓年紀較小的顧客一定會看見它們。
被動語態：be＋p.p.
that 子句：留意名詞子句或關係子句
情態助動詞＋原形動詞
Another eye-catching convenience store strategy is to promote impulse purchases of small, cheap items like candy bars.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
補語／片語Another eye - catching convenience store strategy is to promote impulse purchases of small, cheap items like candy bars.
另一項引人注目的便利商店策略是提高對便宜小物的衝動購物，比如糖果棒。
不定詞：to＋原形動詞
V-ing：動名詞或分詞，依句中功能判斷
These are displayed near cash registers and are thus easily noticed and within quick reach.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
主詞These
動詞are displayed
補語near cash registers and are thus easily noticed and within quick reach.
這些商品會被展示於靠近收銀機的地方，因此容易被注意，而且可以快速取得。
被動語態：be＋p.p.
Special offers, like “buy one, get one free,” make such little “extras” even more attractive.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
修飾語Special offers,
主詞like “buy one, get one free,”
動詞make
受詞such little “extras” even more attractive.
商品特價，像是「買一送一」，使這些小的「額外東西」更加吸引人。
基本句型：先找主詞與動詞，再判斷受詞／補語
Since customers are lining up at cash registers to pay for their things anyway, these items can easily be grabbed and added to their shopping baskets on impulse.
S/V
Clause 1
連接詞Since
主詞customers are lining up at cash registers to pay for their things anyway, these items
動詞can easily
受詞be grabbed and added to their shopping baskets on impulse.
反正因為顧客們正在收銀機排隊以便為他們所買的東西付錢，這些商品可以容易被取得，然後被一時衝動加到他們的購物籃裡。
被動語態：be＋p.p.
副詞子句：主從句時態與連接詞
不定詞：to＋原形動詞
A third strategy is to make customers spend more time in stores so that they will spend more money, too.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
補語／片語A third strategy is to make customers spend more time in stores so that they will spend more money, too.
第三個策略是使顧客在店裡面花更多的時間，他們因此也會花更多的錢。
that 子句：留意名詞子句或關係子句
不定詞：to＋原形動詞
情態助動詞＋原形動詞
Studies have shown that the longer people stay inside, the more products they buy.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
主詞Studies have shown that the longer people stay inside, the more products they
動詞buy
受詞.
研究已經顯示，人們在店裡待得愈久，他們會買愈多的產品。
that 子句：留意名詞子句或關係子句
Shops take advantage of this by setting up bar-style seating or dining areas.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
主詞Shops
動詞take
受詞advantage of this by setting up bar - style seating or dining areas.
便利商店利用這點，設立吧檯式的座位或是用餐區。
V-ing：動名詞或分詞，依句中功能判斷
Here, people can read the paper, hold a meeting, or just hang out.
S/V/O(C)
Clause 1
修飾語Here,
補語／片語people can read the paper, hold a meeting, or just hang out.
在這裡，人們可以看報紙、舉行會議，或只是消磨時間。
V-ing：動名詞或分詞，依句中功能判斷
情態助動詞＋原形動詞

To avoid falling into any of the traps above, try to be more aware of the clever strategies convenience stores use to get deeper into your pocket.
